title: WaterColor "Louisiana Purchase" 95 Dandelion Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count. *This home is allowed 16 amenity access bands.*- 6 King Suites- 12 Bunk beds- Wood Burning Fireplace- Master Media Room Suite with 85" TV- 2000sq ft of Screen Porches / 2 Swinging Beds / 2 Front Porch Swings- Game Room, Pool Table, Ping Pong, Pin Ball- Located across the street from the tennis/pickleball courts- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Louisiana Purchase is an impressive 6-bedroom, 7.5-bathroom home that sleeps an advertised 16. Located in the Woods of Watercolor, this home has nearby bike paths, access to the newly expanded private Watercolor Beach Club, and multiple community pools. Louisiana Purchase is located between Seaside shopping, tennis courts, kids pool with water slides, lazy river, and adult food and beverage. Come enjoy private access to the beach through the Beach Club! This 3-story home features a Southern-inspired wrap-around porch, second-floor balcony with seating, and newly upholstered swings. Entry on the left side of the home opens to a beautiful dining room and kitchen with brick flooring that has a wonderful New Orleans vibe. The great room welcomes guests with a spacious open layout, wood floors, and French doors leading to a vast screened in porch with 85" smart TV. Retire around the woodburning fireplace on 2 oversized sofas and 2 armchairs, or sit around the table with 4 armchairs next to the 6-stool breakfast bar. The 12-seat dining room table and adjoining gourmet kitchen offer high-end appliances! Additional 12 seating outside on the patio table! There are 2 bedrooms on this first floor. One guest room boasting a king bed with double sliding doors and one primary king bedroom with an attached movie room suite featuring an 85" smart TV. There's also a washer and dryer with a large pantry on this floor.Ascend to the second-floor kitchenette with a mini refrigerator, wet bar, and laundry area. There are 4 primary king guest bedrooms with French door access to the covered balconies that all include their own smart TVs. One twin bunk room adjoins one of the primary bedrooms along with a full-sized crib, and 4 additional bunks occupy the hallway with their own bathroom. The second floor living room has a comfy sectional to watch movies on the 70'' smart TV and offers additional sleeping arrangements with its built in bunk beds and extra crib as well.The third-floor vaulted tower has a large game room with a smart TV, pool table, ping pong, pinball machine, and a 6-person game table. Louisiana Purchase was designed with over 2,200 square feet of outdoor living space. With on-site parking for 3 vehicles and 8 adult bikes, it's easy to explore the area. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 16):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate- Bonus Room: King Bed with Shared Powder RoomSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower / Adjoined Twin over Twin and Crib- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin over Twin Bunks with Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub combo- Additional Sleeping: Twin over Twin Bunks & Crib in 2nd floor Living RoomPlease note: Per HOA Policy, all golf cart rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Homes are permitted one golf cart per home. Homes with owner provided golf carts
